# transmit_oncall_configuration (Data Source)

Looks up an on-call configuration by id or name, such as one created by the Opsgenie importer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A configuration created by the Opsgenie importer.
data "transmit_oncall_configuration" "imported" {
  name = "Imported from Opsgenie"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Exact name. The lookup fails if no configuration or more than one has it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `paging_enabled` (Boolean)
- `revision` (Number)
